turns.text: How can I help you
hi. my friend told my ex boyfriend he was an idiot for dumping me. it made me feel uncomfortable since i was in the same room. now he is talking to me again. i think he might want me back

my feelings fluctuate. i resent him that he ended it. it confuses me he still wants to be in my life. he said he wanted to be friends but then asked me out again. i think he is trying to work his way back in. i know i can't keep it up unless he makes it clear he wants to be with me. i don't have time for games
That does sound hard that he is giving mixed signals.
yeah i don't like that. neither does my friend. why she told him he is an idiot for letting me go

yes cuz that's when he wanted me to be around him more
It sounds like your friend got him thinking.
it seemed like it did
Do you feel his change is genuine?
to a degree. i think he has ulterior motives too.
What would he have to do to prove himself?
say he wants me back or something to that effect. i'd like him to be more direct in what he wants from me

yes that would be nice. he tends to beat around the bush then lets me know
Have you talked to anyone else besides your friend about your concerns?  Do you think your family or other friends could give some additional support to you?
yes i've talked to them about it. they've given me some insight into it. i know they want me to be careful. they don't want me to be hurt
That's understandable that they want you to be careful.  My parents and friends watched out for me too.
we are lucky they look out for us. they can't all be wrong if they're guiding us a certain way
I think you hit the nail on the head that it's helpful to have that support.
absolutely. i appreciate your help! nity nite
Thanks.  Can I assist you with anything else?
nope. im good
Have a good night.
